关键词: Amended and Restated Senior Subordinated Convertible Loan And Security Agreement
主要内容: On March 30, 2016, Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. held its previously-announced conference call to discuss its financial results for the fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 2015. During the call, a company representative incorrectly summarized the conversion terms of an initial loan and supplemental loans provided under the Amended and Restated Senior Subordinated Convertible Loan And Security Agreement dated March 28, 2016. The conversion price of $0.54 per share was mistakenly characterized as a 'floor' price. To clarify, the company provided additional disclosure in this Current Report on Form 8-K. The conversion terms include the ability to convert $600,000 in loans (with $300,000 advanced) into shares of common stock at $0.54 per share, determined in accordance with the Letter of Intent dated November 13, 2015. The conversion price for the $150,000 commitment by Supplemental Lenders was determined similarly. The text discusses the conversion price of a loan agreement, which is set at $0.54 per share. This price is determined based on the higher of either 110% of the average closing price of the common stock on the NYSE MKT during the ten trading days before the loan closing date on March 28, 2016, or $0.54. The conversion price may be adjusted for events such as stock dividends, splits, recapitalizations, reclassifications, combinations, exchanges, or similar transactions to ensure lenders receive the same number, kind, and class of shares as if conversion had occurred before the adjustment. Additionally, the conversion price may be reduced if the company issues or sells additional shares at a price below the current conversion price. The adjustment would set the conversion price to the greater of $0.10 or the effective price of the issued shares. The summary is not complete and is referenced to the full text of the Agreement, which is included as Exhibit 10.37 to the Company’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2015.
